name: Vortex VI+
description: This keyword returns the value of the positive line Vortex Indicator of the of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the value of the positive line Vortex Indicator of the of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632225863.png)

You can fetch the Vortex Vi+ on any candle of an instrument, like in the above example, you can fetch the  Vortex Vi+ line  of previous (-1) day candle of Nifty 50 spot
